{{Quote|Ishkah and I go way back, believe it or not. First met her when I was still a mechanic in the army. [...] I'd been retired for awhile, but I was getting bored. So I took the job when Ishkah offered it. And now I'm here on this giant fishbowl. Keeping my head down. Doing the work.|Dux Akko|<ref name="Encounter" />}}
'''Dux Akko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] in the [[Republic Army]]. He was stationed on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]], working for [[Minn Ishkah]].<ref name="Encounter" />
